hook: Stranded near a desert peak. The only way off was a cable.
narration: This man was stranded on a mountain in the Arizona desert, and a cable was the only way off.
He called 911 from the Baboquivari Mountains, southwest of Tucson, in late July.
A Black Hawk crew from Air and Marine Operations found him near Baboquivari Peak.
The rock there was too rugged to land on, so the crew had to hoist him out.
Their emergency medical technician clipped onto the cable and stepped out the door.
The crew lowered him to the slope, and he got a helmet and a harness onto the man.
The helicopter stays high over the rock, [short pause] so only the cable ever touches the mountain.
outcome: Both rode the cable up into the Black Hawk, and the crew airlifted him off the mountain.
title: Hoisted off a peak in the Arizona desert
description:
Air and Marine Operations agents, working with Border Patrol, hoisted a stranded man off the rugged slopes near Baboquivari Peak, southwest of Tucson, Arizona, on July 26, 2021.

Footage: U.S. Customs and Border Protection, Air and Marine Operations video, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/808275/air-and-marine-operations-partnered-with-border-patrol-rescue-stranded-migrant-baboquivari-mountains-near-tucson-arizona
